Definition: , for certain tenses of which a prolonged form ἐρέω is used; and both as alternate for G2036 perhaps akin (or identical) with G4482 (through the idea of pouring forth); to utter, i.e. speak or say:--command, make, say, speak (of). Compare G3004.
